facts.fact: The CSBF, attached to the Banky foiben'i Madagasikara, holds the legal power under the e-money institutions law to grant or withdraw licences, issue regulatory instructions and audit e-money institutions, per 2424.mg.

facts.fact: E-money institutions are legally required to run a 24/7 customer service handling complaints on loss, theft, fraud and unauthorised transactions, with oral complaints confirmed in writing within five working days, per 2424.mg.
